data.revised_prompt:
Create a clean 2D game FX sprite sheet on a solid #FF00FF background, exactly 2 rows by 2 columns (four equal frames). No guide lines, no borders, no labels, no safe-area marks, no card, no UI, no text, no icons. Use the 2x2 layout only for placement and centering. Each frame should contain a centered elegant universal special-card trigger effect, contained well within the central 65% of its cell with nothing crossing cell edges. Style: HD fantasy card-game VFX, crisp and readable at small size, glowing chrysanthemum-like radial light bloom.

Frame 1 (top-left): small warm golden center glow, subtle bloom, softly luminous.
Frame 2 (top-right): many thin petal-like golden rays open evenly around the center, more expansive but still contained.
Frame 3 (bottom-left): full chrysanthemum light burst, clean circular halo, bright layered golden petals, tiny white glints sparkling near the core.
Frame 4 (bottom-right): rays fade into soft golden sparkles and a transparent halo, lighter and more airy, dissipating gracefully.

Use luminous gold, warm amber, and small white highlights. Effect only, no explosion, no fire, no smoke, no fragments, no tearing. Keep each frame centered and consistent in scale, with a polished magical light-bloom appearance.
